criteria.text: Manuscript contains an abstract of at most 250 words
Reference list has at least five major sources, no more than two internet-only sites
Chapter 1 states the research problem and its significance
criteria.evidence_needed: Chapter 1, sections 1.1-1.2 — clarity and depth of the problem statement

criteria.text: Findings are discussed with reference to prior literature, on a Beginner(1)-Developing(2)-Proficient(3)-Exemplary(4) scale
criteria.evidence_needed: Chapter 4 discussion; scale: 1=no comparison, 4=thorough critical comparison
